description: x402-hyperliquid-funding: Hyperliquid funding-rate history for one perpetual, with the summary a carry trade needs (current rate, mean, annualized mean, min/max, share of positive periods, direction of drift). Funding is paid hourly and is the main cost of holding a perp, so this is the number that decides whether a position is worth keeping.
